target_customer: Teams building computer vision models that need labeled visual data
problem: Labeling images and video and iterating on annotations is slow and expensive, which delays building computer vision models.
business_model: B2B software, AI agent (IRIS) that auto labels, trains and deploys vision models (pricing not found)
product_category: AI data labeling and computer vision model building

founders.name: Kelly Lu
founders.background_notes: YC page: infrastructure at Discord covering revenue infrastructure and checkout flow optimization.

founders.name: Anirudh Rahul
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Ani; high performance trading systems and computer vision research at MIT.

technical_complexity.rationale: An agent that labels visual data from prompts, takes feedback and trains and deploys models needs vision foundation models plus orchestration, with accuracy hard to guarantee.

defensibility.rationale: Zero shot labeling relies on shared foundation models and the earlier open source project shows the approach is easy to replicate.

market_need_then: The YC launch post pitched going from idea to a vision model 100 times faster. Dated demand evidence was not collected.

branding.domain_note: Uses overeasy.sh. The name is shared with an egg product trademark, a coffee brand and an unrelated VC firm.
branding.community_and_virality: Open source Overeasy GitHub project for zero shot vision pipelines.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found and the name collides with many unrelated Over Easy brands.

outcome_analysis: Overeasy is listed as active with a team of two. It started from an open source vision pipeline project and launched through YC in 2024 with the IRIS labeling agent. No funding, customers or press were found, so traction is unknown.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 503 so it could not be read. No funding found beyond the standard YC deal; funding_data_coverage none_found. An Extruct page lists Scale AI and others as competitors but misdescribes the company as voice AI, so ignored. Competitor searches returned no dated sources, so the list is empty.
